0022600004.text: Both teams open their 2026-27 seasons when the Miami Heat host the Minnesota Timberwolves, a matchup in which the Heat lost both meetings in 2025-26, most recently 122-94 in Minneapolis on January 6, 2026, and ESPN's matchup predictor gives Miami a 50% chance to win. Miami's Bam Adebayo (groin), Dru Smith (calf strain), Ezra Ausar (undisclosed), Giannis Antetokounmpo (rest), and Pelle Larsson (illness) are all listed as day-to-day and game-time decisions. Minnesota is without Donte DiVincenzo, who is out following Achilles surgery, while Anthony Edwards, Ayo Dosunmu, Bones Hyland, Enrique Freeman, Jaden McDaniels, Jonathan Kuminga, LaMelo Ball, Rocco Zikarsky, Rudy Gobert, and Trey Lyles are listed as day-to-day, with rest given as the reason for most of them.
